Layout and proportions only: the intakes' spread against the fuselage, the fins' cant, the wing's dihedral, the gear track. The canards blend into the wing in it; the seed is not honoured by the gateway, so it does not reproduce.
entries.prompt: Chengdu J-20 stealth fighter of the PLA Air Force, exact head-on front view (camera on the aircraft's centreline at cockpit height, straight at the nose), standing on its landing gear on a concrete apron in daylight, photographic reference. Long pointed chined nose, bubble canopy, the two caret diverterless intakes either side of the cockpit, the canards just behind the intakes with slight anhedral, the large delta wings behind, the two all-moving vertical fins canted strongly outward, the two small ventral fins canted outward under the tail, tricycle landing gear with the main gear folding out of the fuselage. Dark grey low-visibility paint. Whole aircraft in frame and symmetric, no people, no text.
